note: Lightweight backlog of articles discovered (primarily from the Snacks Weekly on Data Science podcast's episodes) but not yet written up as full deep-dive entries. The daily refresh Routine upgrades stubs to full entries over time: it deep-summarises the top items here, writes them into articles/ + index.json, and removes them from this file. Episode enumeration is best-effort via web search because the podcast's full feed/list is egress-blocked in this environment (~45 of 101 episodes recovered so far). URLs are the underlying company article where known; null means the deepening step should locate it.

stubs.title: Small Area Causal Inference
stubs.hook: Estimates area-specific causal effects with empirical best prediction under a linear mixed model instead of doubly robust estimation, trading bias for variance to minimise mean squared prediction error in small areas.

stubs.title: Sequential Conditional Paired-Sample Testing with Applications to Online Monitoring
stubs.hook: SCPT: an anytime-valid test of whether two conditional distributions are equal given covariates, built from sequential conditional kernel discrepancies and test martingales, for model monitoring and online comparisons with no fixed sample size.

stubs.title: Inference for Heterogeneous Treatment Effects with Deep Survival Learners
stubs.hook: Deep survival learning for time-varying CATEs: neural networks for covariate effects plus a shared spline representation of time, with valid inference for time-varying treatment effects and their contrasts.

stubs.title: IntentGR: Enhancing Intent for End-to-End Personalized Generative Retrieval in Search
stubs.hook: Uses the search query to guide both semantic-ID tokenization and sequence generation in end-to-end personalized generative retrieval, so generated SIDs reflect immediate intent as well as long-term preference.

stubs.title: Personal data classification at scale
stubs.hook: Classifying and protecting personal data across a large data estate.

stubs.title: Covariate selection in causal inference
stubs.hook: Choosing covariates well to get unbiased causal estimates.

stubs.title: Generative AI to create new food recipes
stubs.hook: Using generative models to invent new recipes.

stubs.title: Handling data imbalance in text models with automated augmentation
stubs.hook: Automated augmentation techniques to fix class imbalance in text data.

stubs.title: From One Horizontal Scaling Controller to Many: Evolving Uber's Compute Platform
stubs.hook: Evolving Uber's internal compute platform from a single horizontal-scaling controller to multiple, addressing scaling bottlenecks as workloads (including ML) grew.

stubs.title: Agentic Resource Discovery (ARD): An Open Specification for Agent Discovery
stubs.hook: AWS backs an open cross-environment discovery standard (ARD) as a federation layer over its own Agent Registry for governing AI agents, tools, and skills at scale.

stubs.title: High-Throughput Structure Prediction with BioNeMo Inference Runtime
stubs.hook: Accelerates biomolecular structure prediction at proteome scale through an optimized inference pipeline, illustrating domain-specialized inference-runtime design.

stubs.title: Accelerating Coupang's AI Journey with LLMs
stubs.hook: Coupang engineering's account of scaling LLM adoption across search, ads, catalog, and recommendations, moving from classical ML to LLM-driven workflows.

stubs.title: Engineering AI 'coworkers' that live in Slack
stubs.hook: Software you @mention in Slack like a coworker that remembers past discussions, follows up on dropped threads, and pushes back when asked to do something it shouldn't.

stubs.title: A Decade of AI Platform at Pinterest
stubs.hook: A retrospective on how Pinterest's internal ML platform evolved over ten years to support its current recommendation and ads systems.

stubs.title: 1,500+ PRs Later: Spotify's Journey with Its Background Coding Agent (Honk)
stubs.hook: The background coding agent whose adoption is the direct driver behind the throughput increase examined in Spotify's later AI-quality-at-velocity post.

stubs.title: Ava: Instacart's Internal AI Assistant
stubs.hook: An internal AI assistant built on GPT-4/GPT-3.5 to help Instacart employees with day-to-day work, part of the company's broader AI-driven-development push.

stubs.title: SPAR: Enhancing Industrial-Scale Generative POI Recommendation via Real-World Spatial Perception
stubs.hook: Adds real-world spatial-perception signals to a generative (semantic-ID) point-of-interest recommender at industrial scale.

stubs.title: Time Series Change Point Detection with Gaussian Processes
stubs.hook: A Gaussian-process hypothesis-testing framework for offline and online multiple change-point detection, defining a change as a shift in GP hyperparameters.

stubs.title: RecoGEM: A Serving System for Production-Scale Generative Recommendation
stubs.hook: Serving system for generative recommenders, whose dependent autoregressive decoding steps sit on the latency-critical path.

stubs.title: Offline Learning of Reserve Prices from Censored Bids
stubs.hook: When can an auction's optimal reserve be identified from bids censored at past reserves? Characterizes identification under MHR and a minimax-regret reserve depending on two observable quantities.

stubs.title: KuaiRecV2: Benchmarking Large-Scale Continual Learning for Diversified and Multi-task Recommendation
stubs.hook: A benchmark aimed at the offline-online evaluation gap in recsys: continual learning under shifting item pools, accuracy-diversity trade-offs, and multi-task objectives.

stubs.title: RecMem: Recurrent Memory Compression for Long-Sequence Generative Recommendation
stubs.hook: Compresses long histories into 16 forget-gated memory slots on an HSTU backbone; on MerRec keeps 87.9% of HSTU-1200's Recall@10 with a 216-token vs 1,200-token decoder context.

stubs.title: Constrained Stochastic Policy Targeting under Heterogeneous Partial Interference
stubs.hook: Learns individualized stochastic treatment policies that hit an outcome target with minimal treatment under spillovers (interference-aware IPW, finite-sample regret); applied to a Colombian conditional cash transfer.

stubs.title: Straight to the Product: What Online Retailers Miss When Shoppers Ask AI First
stubs.hook: Links people's AI-assistant shopping conversations to their later browsing at 20 large retailers: visits to the named product rise from 0.02 to 2.07 per 100 answers, yet 89% of those visits carry no sign of the assistant's link — an attribution blind spot.

stubs.title: Honest confidence sets under experiment-level failure
stubs.hook: Minimax theory for confidence sets that stay honest when a whole experiment can fail with a declared probability; deterministic procedures have full-range worst-case diameter, while independent randomisation achieves sharp minimax risks.

stubs.title: IntentFlow: An Intent-Driven Real-Time Multimodal Search System with Image-Text Queries at Xiaohongshu
stubs.hook: Deployed image-text query search over UGC notes that models retrieval intent explicitly so candidate retrieval and reranking share one relevance criterion, since reranking visual results alone misses intent-relevant notes.

stubs.title: Reflection Is Not Always Worth It: Budgeted Reflection Allocation for Recommendation Agents
stubs.hook: BRAVE allocates training-time LLM reflection across users under a budget to make recommendation agents cheaper while preserving full-catalog ranking; flags the risk of under-serving sparse or niche users.
